workstreams.name: Identify core legal claims under Austrian civil law
workstreams.goal: Determine applicable claims (e.g., warranty, tort, contract) against Ofenbau AG based on factual defects and additional damage

workstreams.name: Analyze subcontractor liability and principal responsibility
workstreams.goal: Clarify whether Ofenbau AG is liable for acts of Allerlei GmbH under § 1306 ABGB (vicarious liability) and relevant RS

workstreams.name: Assess damages and mitigation (Neuaufbau vs. Marktwert)
workstreams.goal: Evaluate whether full replacement cost (EUR 10.000) is claimable or limited to market value; examine duty to mitigate under § 1323 ABGB

synthesis_focus: Liability of principal contractor for subcontractor defects and subsequent damage, with emphasis on warranty scope (§§ 1320 ff. ABGB), vicarious liability (§ 1306 ABGB), and damage limitation principles (§ 1323 ABGB), using OGH RS and commentary to resolve Neuaufbau vs. Marktwert conflict.
